llm.sql:
SELECT
  AVG(customer_spend.total_spent) AS average_spend_per_customer
FROM (
  SELECT
    all_orders.customer_id,
    SUM(all_orders.quantity * products.price) AS total_spent
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, product_id, quantity FROM "orders"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT customer_id, product_id, quantity FROM orders_archive
  ) AS all_orders
  JOIN products ON all_orders.product_id = products.id
  GROUP BY all_orders.customer_id
) AS customer_spend

  AVG(customer_spend.total_spent) AS average_spend_per_customer
FROM (

  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, product_id, quantity FROM "orders"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT customer_id, product_id, quantity FROM orders_archive
  ) AS all_orders
  JOIN products ON all_orders.product_id = products.id
  GROUP BY all_orders.customer_id
) AS customer_spend
